caption: The drawing features a single clear glass tumbler, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The glass is cylindrical with vertical, faceted sides that create a pattern of repeating panels. The rim of the glass is round and slightly wider than the base. The glass is depicted with varying shades of blue, purple, yellow, and faint green, representing the transparency and reflective qualities of glass, and there are some orange or reddish areas near the base indicating either reflections or highlights. The interior of the glass holds a small amount of water, with the waterline visible and colored in light blue and beige tones. The drawing is bordered by two thin hand-drawn rectangular lines, one inside the other, and the artist’s signature "J. Howard / GMS. 1936." is written at the bottom center below the inner border. There is no other object or pattern on the background.
title: Glass
